schema: V260 source original nine graphical choices compared by manual topology full three-by-three
basis: V257 native source DrawingML shapes/anchors and V258 fingerprints, nine actual original Excel B/C/D option drawings; approximate visual transcriptions to human-specified circuit graphs.

modelDefinitions.A_SHARED: One central X breaker links selector hub {L_UP,L_DOWN} to {R_UP,R_DOWN}. Four alternative selector pairs: two longitudinal + two diagonal.
modelDefinitions.B30: One central X links {L_UP,R_DOWN} to {L_DOWN,R_UP}. Four alternative selector pairs: two longitudinal + two transversal, no diagonal through that breaker.
modelDefinitions.C30: Two geometric same-level routes L_UP-R_UP and L_DOWN-R_DOWN, with blank-circle and crossed-circle symbols NOT proven standard breaker devices.
modelDefinitions.B31: Two separate X paths: L_UP-R_DOWN and L_DOWN-R_UP; two physical diagonal routes.
modelDefinitions.B32: Two X paths: L_UP-R_DOWN and L_DOWN-R_DOWN; suspected direct R_UP-R_DOWN junction cannot qualify as breaker-controlled transversal.
modelDefinitions.C_SHARED: One X connects {L_UP,R_UP} to {L_DOWN,R_DOWN}; four alternative modes: two transversal and two diagonal.

sourceGraphAssumptions: Each image is a single-line diagram of four physically distinct section/level busbar terminal nodes L_UP,L_DOWN,R_UP,R_DOWN. A line crossing without a junction marker may NOT connect.
Only through-breaker routes counted; closing parallel isolators on the same side of breaker is not a substitute for proper protected coupler.
A single shared breaker yields selectable modes sequentially, not two simultaneously independent couplers; two separate X symbols can represent two branches only after topological validation.
The source preview renderer uses approximate SVG rendering of DrawingML; topology models are manually entered and not generated from a verified machine netlist.
Row EL30 C and EL32 B contain symbol/junction uncertainty that cannot be fully resolved via these models alone.

C.symbol_hold: Cross-in-circle and blank circle are not asserted to be standard X breaker marks.

B.possible_unprotected_tie: R_UP to R_DOWN; crossing vs actual junction not certified

riskAndGuardrails: Not an ANRE scored answer key, even though the apparent intended pattern A/A/C matches a third-party explanation.
Manual graph tests are deterministic unit tests of proposed topology, not proof that proposed topology matches every junction in official Excel display.
No 2026 validity or exam key certification.
Do not alter canonical bank, A/B/C or program based on this research.
